changelog: v0.7.1 — Autofill fixes: Remember now works (it failed every time in 0.7.0) and is also captured on Mark as Applied; on Lever/Ashby posting pages Autofill presses Apply and fills the form itself; works on forms embedded in company career sites; the report separates required questions from optional ones; essays are never remembered. The panel no longer navigates away when opened mid-application, and it follows the tab — open a queued job yourself and the panel selects it.
